notes.title: Important news:
notes.notes:
I am excited to announce that in the coming days, all of my products will become completely free.

This is because I want everyone to be able to play and enjoy my creations.

I truly thank from the bottom of my heart all the people who have bought my video games over the years, supporting me and their development.

Thank you so much to everyone, and I hope this announcement will be well received.

notes.notes: Soon a cool new trailer will be released and I am working to prepare the software to be ready to be recorded in the best way. Stay Tuned for future updates.

notes.title: DEFINITIVE EDITION IS LIVE NOW!
notes.notes:
Finally, after a lot of works,[b] DEFINITIVE EDITION [/b] is here.

Main features are:
- Fully reworked graphycs
- Fully reworked environments
- Improved Game Design
- Added more weapons
- Major and other minor improvements

The game will be continous improved with future updates following community feedbacks.

notes.notes:
After more than 2 years, I come back to AFTERLIFE to improve overall game. From graphycs to gameplay. It will require some times. Update after update we will se the game evolve. 
I published the DEFINITIVE EDITION (available for free to everybody has already the game from this steam page) in order to get your feedbacks during development. Soon all store images and trailers will be updated.

notes.title: AFTERLIFE : KILLING DEATH
notes.notes:
My aim is to share my message through the videogame art and make my art live forever.

I developed AFTERLIFE to tell you my vision of the actual society, representing it in a dystopian way. Live this game as a message and try to go across the surface. Go deep and discover the real meaning of AFTERLIFE : KILLING DEATH.
